name: rf-grow-co
description: Standalone hobby game, NOT a Farming Simulator product. First-person shop simulator: grow, cure, pack and sell, run a basement cigarette works, fight off robbers, and drive around a small open town.
author: TheCodingDad-TisonK

scripts.check: node node_modules/co-engine/tools/build-game.js --check && node node_modules/co-engine/tools/sync-version.js && node node_modules/co-engine/tools/lint-gate.js game && node node_modules/co-engine/tools/check-syntax.js
scripts.dist: npm run check && npm run icon && node tools/verify-icon.js && electron-packager . "Grow Co" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=build/icon.ico --app-copyright="TheCodingDad-TisonK" --ignore="^/dist" --ignore="^/docs" --ignore="^/gallery" --ignore="^/tools" --ignore="^/src" --ignore="^/tests" --ignore="^/build" --ignore="^/\.github" --ignore="^/\.git" --prune=true
scripts.installer: npm run check && npm run icon && node tools/verify-icon.js && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
